title: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" Secures First MPA Rating for AI Movie
summary:
A production team is preparing for a theatrical release on December 4 for a feature film created entirely via artificial intelligence. The motion picture, titled "Gods Don't Give Gifts," is the first fully AI-generated movie to earn an official rating from the Motion Picture Association, and the filmmakers are now initiating a campaign for the Academy Awards.

The film features a plot in which humans upload their consciousness into synthetic bodies. It is also the first AI-generated project to appear on a mainstream trailer channel, a milestone the creators suggest challenges the traditional industry reliance on human actors, animators, and studio budgets.
